limitations: The workload is the deterministic synthetic Helix CPU demo, not production traffic.
A negative overhead estimate inside the measured noise floor is not a speedup claim.
Resource sampling is periodic and can miss peaks between 100 ms samples.
Lifecycle events are buffered in memory during the timed run; canonical adaptation and trace persistence are measured separately by the vertical trace workflow.

metric_availability.branch_readiness_ns: AVAILABLE for minimal/full; disabled mode has no wrappers
metric_availability.cpu_utilization: AVAILABLE as process CPU time divided by wall time
metric_availability.gpu_utilization: UNAVAILABLE: no compatible GPU execution occurred
metric_availability.learning_transaction_latency: AVAILABLE as full run wall time
metric_availability.memory: AVAILABLE as 100 ms sampled process RSS/VMS
metric_availability.per_token_latency_ns: UNAVAILABLE: fixture emits policy decisions, not model-server token timings
metric_availability.rollout_throughput: AVAILABLE for minimal/full; disabled mode has no wrappers
metric_availability.storage_writes: AVAILABLE as psutil process I/O where supported plus artifact bytes
metric_availability.ttft_ns: UNAVAILABLE: reference CPU policy demo has no model-server TTFT
